title: Uranium in the Desert: From a Contested Colonial Resource to Major Global Supplier for China
summary: Traces Namibia's uranium industry from the 1928 discovery near the Rössing Mountains and the controversial colonial-era Rössing mine to its rise as a top-three global producer, explaining why China, now the dominant investor in Namibia's major mines, is so interested in the country, which has a strong nuclear regulator but no nuclear power plants.

title: Amazon and Constellation Bet $3B on Maryland Nuclear
summary: A LinkedIn post by TheJobWalk on Constellation and Amazon's 20-year deal for 690 megawatts from Maryland's Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant, unlocking more than $3 billion in infrastructure investment including about 190 megawatts of new capacity between 2030 and 2032.

title: Forge-350: A U.S. Nuclear Design and Implementation Guide
summary: Evaluates known nuclear plant types against U.S. efficiency, safety, licensing, and economic constraints, then proposes Forge-350, a fluoride-salt-cooled, TRISO-fueled plant for repowering coal sites with decoupled nitrate-salt storage, plus a path from site screening to commercial operation.

title: Meridian Economic and Infrastructure Charter: A Public Proposal
summary: Proposes a listed development corporation, chartered by treaty with Namibia, Botswana, South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique, to build and administer consented land parcels under a published charter, drawing lessons from historical chartered companies.

title: From Motor Brain-Computer Interfaces to a Closed-Loop Cognitive Copilot
summary: A phased research concept that rejects the idea of a 'merged mind' and instead tests whether a person can do harder intellectual work through a narrow, auditable BCI channel to an external AI model, measured against keyboard use on pre-registered tasks.
